Checked Sep 30, 2026. Confirmed against the sources at the foot of this page. Check the host’s page before you go

How we know

TriScottsdale’s group workouts page lists ‘The 6 hill group ride’ on Thursdays, 5:35 to 7:20 am, Village Tavern, 8787 N. Scottsdale. The page shows no dates; the site’s sitemap shows it was last published Feb 1, 2026 (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

Hosted by
TriScottsdaleClub
Kind of ride
Road

For visitors

The club’s page says ‘or just show up’; its waiver is on the club’s site. Pre-sunrise start most of the year, so bring front and rear lights. The page lists the ride with no dates, so check with the club before a first visit.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:35 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
A set of short hills in a row at Hidden Hills. The club says it sometimes swaps the six hills for something else.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the TriScottsdale Six-Hill Thursday Ride group ride

TriScottsdale Six-Hill Thursday Ride is a road group ride in Scottsdale, AZ. It rolls every Thursday at 5:35 am from Village Tavern.

TriScottsdale’s Thursday hill ride. It heads north from the Village Tavern to Hidden Hills for a set of short hills in a row. The club says every so often it exchanges the six hills for something else.
